screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.

slides.silent_read: While already moving toward a closing elevator, two separate people reverse together for one last functional check of the fully closed exterior door: he unequivocally depresses the lever while she forcefully pushes the separate door panel. A pull or resistance test by him is probable, but the visible evidence proves handle operation more strongly than an actual pulling vector.
slides.change_from_previous: The wet roadside chai close-up cuts to a pristine dry corridor medium-wide shot, making the final beat a deliberate nonlinear callback to the couple's departure ritual.
slides.critic_evidence: The camera is entirely outside the apartment and the central door is visibly fully closed. The figures remain separate on one depth plane with clear empty space between their torsos, eliminating a merged-body or one-person reading. The man's five fingers wrap the exterior lever and the lever visibly angles downward under his grip, making handle depression unequivocal. His hips and shoes remain directed toward the elevator while his torso twists back to the handle, supporting a last-second return and likely tug or resistance check. The woman's elbow is locked straight, her shoulder and upper torso transfer weight through her palm, her sleeve compresses, and pressure ticks mark the contact point; together these distinguish a forceful panel push from casual touching or passive bracing. Her pushing hand contacts the center-left panel while his hand separately operates the right-edge handle, so the two actions share one target without overlapping. The halfway-closing elevator, glowing call button, elevator-pointing lower bodies, lifted returning heel, and heel motion trail visibly establish movement away from the door followed by reversal. The pristine clothes, dry shoes and floor, tightly rolled unused umbrella, and outing tote strongly establish a pre-rain, pre-outing state. Placed after the rainy chai frame, the abrupt restoration of dry clothing and unused umbrella strongly signals a rewind or callback rather than immediate chronological continuation.

story_evidence.carrier: Depressed handle, locked pushing elbow, sleeve compression, palm-pressure ticks, outward-pointing lower bodies, Aachu's reversing heel, closing elevator, and pristine departure objects.
story_evidence.observable_state: Both people are outside one fully closed door. He operates its handle while she separately transfers body weight through her palm into the panel after starting toward the elevator; nothing shows rain exposure or a completed outing.
story_evidence.narrative_job: Prove that she went back and functionally joined his check while keeping the moment before departure.

continuity.incoming_state: The rainy outing has reached playful repair.
continuity.outgoing_state: A dry nonlinear bookend reveals that their shared habit was already present at the departure threshold.

resolved_ambiguities.competing_read: Earlier generated frames showed one partner checking while the other hugged, watched, or checked alone.
resolved_ambiguities.repair: The new staging separates the torsos, forbids couple touch, assigns one focal action arm to each partner, and makes both people look at their own door contact.
resolved_ambiguities.recheck_evidence: The fresh copy-hidden critic read two separate people reversing together for one functional check and described the relationship state as coordinated and equal in a shared practical ritual.

resolved_ambiguities.competing_read: Aachu's earlier flat palm could read as casual touching or bracing rather than checking.
resolved_ambiguities.repair: Her elbow is locked straight, shoulder and torso weight transfer through the arm, the sleeve compresses, and two pressure ticks mark the panel contact while Zuv operates the handle in the opposite direction.
resolved_ambiguities.recheck_evidence: The fresh critic said these combined carriers distinguish a forceful panel push from casual touching or passive bracing and make that competing reading substantially weaker.

resolved_ambiguities.competing_read: A static corridor frame could not prove that Aachu went back or that the beat happened before the outing.
resolved_ambiguities.repair: The halfway-closing elevator, glowing call button, outward-pointing lower bodies, lifted reversing heel, heel-motion trail, pristine clothes, dry floor, tote, and unused umbrella establish an interrupted departure.
resolved_ambiguities.recheck_evidence: The fresh critic inferred they had begun walking toward the elevator, simultaneously doubted the door, reversed, and would resume the outing after the check.

resolved_ambiguities.competing_read: A visible key or fob could turn the scene into unlocking or a post-date arrival.
resolved_ambiguities.repair: Every key and fob is omitted; the flexed handle and weighted panel push carry the check.
resolved_ambiguities.recheck_evidence: The fresh critic read a secured-door test before the outing and noted that the absence of a key prevents direct unlocking evidence.
